decisions.executionNote: Begin left elbow-up approach toward the rear-left white support, using small continuous forward and wrist-tilt increments.
Align open left fingers to the rear-left block at its observed yaw; warm up the right arm toward the front-right support without crossing.
Use wrist views to center and close on the left support; lower and yaw-align the open right gripper around the nearer right support.
Lift the closed left grasp to verify retention and begin moving toward the left foundation position; refine the right block alignment, close, and test a small lift.
Both white blocks remain centered in the wrist views. Transport them upright to symmetric foundation locations, yaw-aligning with the boards and lowering the left one cautiously.
Set the left support down and open, withdrawing upward; finish centering and lowering the right support to the same foundation height.
Release the right foundation block, then withdraw both grippers upward and outward. Reorient for a symmetric two-handed grasp of the long lower board.
Complete mirrored inward-facing board-grasp orientations while keeping both wrists above and outside the long board.
Lower both open grippers symmetrically to the ends of the long board, keeping its width centered between the fingers.
Close around both board ends and lift vertically together, checking that the board remains level and retained before translation.
The long board is retained at both ends. Raise for support clearance, carry it centered over the two foundation blocks, then begin a level descent.
Seat the lower board gently on both upright supports, open both grippers together, and withdraw upward/outward to inspect stability.
The lower board rests stably across its supports. Reorient the open grippers above the two remaining white blocks for the middle layer.
Refine block yaw and lateral alignment from both wrist views, descending with open fingers to just above grasp height.
Center both white blocks between the fingers using close wrist feedback, close fully, and test retention with a short vertical lift.
Raise both retained middle supports above the completed lower board and transport inward with their long axes aligned to the tower; keep both grippers fully closed.
Center the middle supports symmetrically and lower them onto the lower board. Compensate the deeper right grasp, release gently, then begin withdrawing for inspection.
Withdraw without disturbing the placed middle supports, then turn the open wrists into mirrored board-grasp orientations above the shorter board.
Finish symmetric wrist alignment and lower the open grippers to the ends of the shorter board, leaving the completed lower layer untouched.
Close both grippers on the shorter board and lift it level to clear the middle supports before moving toward the tower.
Carry the retained middle board level over the two centered supports, keeping clearance during translation and beginning a slow final descent.
Seat and release the centered middle board, then withdraw both grippers symmetrically upward and outward to verify the layer remains stable.
The middle layer remains upright and centered. Approach the green roof from the left and the small wooden top board from the right, staying clear of the tower.
Correct the right grasp laterally toward the small board using the head and wrist views; lower the left open fingers toward the roof without touching the completed tower.
Refine the roof grip position and close the left fingers; yaw-align the right fingers with the small board and descend carefully toward its thin edges.
Lift the closed left roof grasp to verify retention. Close the right gripper across the small board and lift it clear, retaining both pieces without opening.
Both top pieces remain retained. Stage the roof safely left of the tower; raise and turn the small board so its long axis will align with the lower boards before centering.
Hold the roof staged clear on the left. Finish aligning and centering the retained small board over the middle layer, descending only to a checking height.
Gently center and seat the small board, release the right gripper, and move it clear. Raise the retained roof for a collision-free final placement.
Move the retained roof over the centered top board and descend to a checking height. Withdraw the empty right arm toward home with continuous wrist rotation.
Center and seat the upright roof on the small board, open the left gripper, and withdraw without contact. Continue returning the empty right arm toward its origin.
All tower pieces appear upright and centered after release. Return the left arm clear of the tower with smooth elbow-up motion, and ease the right arm to its origin.
Continue the left arm's smooth return toward origin with both grippers open, preserving elbow-up continuity and leaving the stable tower undisturbed.
